title: Report to the Secretary of State for India in Council on Railways in India to the End of the Year 1859
version: First report in the digitized annual report compilation, selected original page images
lineage: Government Director’s published report. The excerpt retains the cited pages from the digitized compilation. Accounts in this report may draw on operator returns.

passages.note: The Government Director’s section-opening table dates Bombay to Tannah to 18 April 1853 in a row grouped with the Mahim branch and lists Tannah to Callian separately on 1 May 1854.

Danvers identifies the August 1849 Bombay–Callian construction agreement with the East India Company, the initial opening and subsequent extension, the subscribed railway capital, and guaranteed interest received by the railway company.
The company-level return records 535,195 passenger conveyances and £13,647 of passenger receipts for the year ending 30 June 1854, with 35 miles open in the row.

file.method: Poppler pdfseparate per requested page, then pdfunite in the listed order.
